There are 38 Russian AI companies, and it is worth analysing their backgrounds, classifications, and the links between them and the Russian state. 
The post The Kremlin: AI ecosystem architect appeared first on Gateway House.

title: The UN changes guard
description:
The process of choosing a new Secretary General of the UN, to assume office on January 1, 2027, has begun. The UN Security Council is central to this and has just held its first straw poll on the seven candidates in the fray. Three have done well – all from countries with positive ties to the current U.S. administration. India must keep a close eye on the developments.
The post The UN changes guard appeared first on Gateway House.
